Ahead of time tracing, lowering and compilation

Source: R/stages.R
jax_stages.Rd

Port of jax.stages. A function made by jit() has the methods of JAX's Wrapped protocol, reached with $:

Usage

# S3 method for class 'jax_jitted'
x$name

# S3 method for class 'jax_stage'
x$name

# S3 method for class 'jax_stage'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'jax_jitted'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A function made by jit(), or a stage.

name

Field or method name.

...

Ignored.

Value

The field, or a function for a method.

Details

  • f$trace(...) traces f for the given arguments and returns a Traced stage.

  • f$lower(...) is f$trace(...)$lower(): a Lowered stage.

  • f$eval_shape(...) returns the shapes and dtypes of the result (eval_shape()).

  • f$clear_cache() drops the compiled versions of f.

The arguments can be arrays or ShapeDtypeStruct() values. Each stage is read with $ as well:

StageFields and methods
Tracedjaxpr, fun_name, lower(); a Traced stage is a function and can be called
Loweredas_text(dialect = NULL), compiler_ir(dialect = NULL), compile(), cost_analysis()
Compiledas_text(), cost_analysis(), memory_analysis(), runtime_executable(), call(...); a Compiled stage is a function and can be called
allargs_info, out_info, in_tree, out_tree, in_avals

as_text() of a Lowered stage is the StableHLO module (the only dialect). The analyses return NULL, as they do in JAX when the backend provides none. A Compiled stage takes the non static arguments of f, accepts only the shapes and dtypes it was compiled for, and cannot be transformed again.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- jit(function(x) jnp_sum(x^2))
lowered <- f$lower(as_jax(c(1, 2, 3)))
cat(lowered$as_text())
compiled <- lowered$compile()
compiled(as_jax(c(1, 2, 3)))
} # }
